prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One sun hat front three-quarter view with a round crown, broad brim and plain ribbon band, no weave.
Pure outline drawing, empty white interiors, no gray fill or cast shadow. Only requested components. Absolutely no repeated stitch dashes, hatch marks, weaving texture or decorative motifs. All objects fully visible and contained within generous 10 percent margins.
